# Head Coach

This pivotal role is held by an extremely dedicated, experienced member of the 
coaching squad. Their diligence in creation of a suitable, challenging training
plan for all squads and their knowledge of each swimmer's goals and abilities
means this role is key to getting the best out of every swimmer.

## Key Responsibilities

- Design and deliver comprehensive training plans for top performance squads down to younger age-group tiers
- Ensure all poolside coaching sessions are adequately staffed and well run
- Direct pool training sessions and oversee land-based conditioning
- Monitor swimmer progression, coordinate squad moves, and determine event or gala entries
- Mentor, support, and supervise assistant coaches
- Help coordinate staff rotas and host regular coaching meetings
- Foster a positive, safe, and inclusive team culture aligned with club philosophy
- Work alongside the club committee and chair to help shape the club’s long-term strategy and performance targets
- Write and deliver an annual head coach's report to the AGM

## Requirements

- Current DBS certificate
- Safeguarding training
